page: Microsoft Azure E2nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is provisioned with 2 dedicated vCPUs based on x86_64 Intel processors and provides 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. As part of the network-optimized Endv6 series, the instance is engineered for memory-intensive operations while maintaining direct access to dedicated compute resources without shared CPU contention.

The instance includes 118 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage. The local NVMe disk provides low-latency ephemeral scratch space, while external Premium Storage capability allows persistent block storage attachment. The platform features no integrated GPUs and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, operating within configured private virtual network topologies.

With its 1:8 compute-to-memory balance and dedicated local NVMe disk, the E2nds_v6 delivers cost-efficient resource density for workloads demanding high memory per core without requiring high thread parallelism. Primary workload fits include small-scale relational databases, in-memory caching tiers like Redis, intermediate ETL staging operations, and backend microservices that benefit from local high-speed temporary storage and high memory overhead.
